spec: verify_sssp checks a single-source result without trusting the algorithm: sizes, dist[source]=0, parent edge existence/endpoints, tree distance consistency, acyclic parent pointers reaching the source, unreachable <=> infinite with no parent (checked by BFS), the optimality certificate dist[v] <= dist[u]+w on every arc, and optional reference agreement; exact for integers, gamma_k tolerance for doubles; JSON dump for exact rational checking
paper_ref: none (comparison-addition model, Sec 2, is the reason exact and rounded checks are separated)
